audit.whatIsWrong: LeBlanc wins 45.65% of 3334 games, yet the level chart gave LeBlanc all seven stages and the page called the lane EVEN at 5.5/10 (packet defect flagged this).
audit.why: Naafiri out-ranges LeBlanc at level 1 (Darkin Daggers 900 vs Sigil 700) and beats her from 6 onward: Hounds' Pursuit is a 900-range lock-on dash with a shielded recast, and W/E/R all grant untargetable frames that blank a timed burst. LeBlanc's real window is levels 2-5, where the Q-W double proc lands and Eviscerate is on 11s.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 4, 5 and 6 moved to Naafiri with matching whys and ratings; rows 1-3 stay LeBlanc. diff HARD, diffRating 6.5/10, carryRating 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were written as if level 6 and first item belonged to LeBlanc.
audit.why: Naafiri's level-6 spike is larger: Hounds' Pursuit needs no aim, recasts into a shield, and her lethality item plus Eviscerate's full pack heal win the extended trade LeBlanc cannot refuse once locked on.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claimed Naafiri 'has no ranged tools' and that her passive resets on takedowns. Neither is in the kit: Darkin Daggers is 900 range, and the passive only spawns packmates.
audit.why: Untargetability on The Call of the Pack (W), Eviscerate (E) and Hounds' Pursuit (R) is the decisive interaction — LeBlanc's damage is a timed burst and every one of those frames eats it. Eviscerate also fully heals her packmates, which is the anti-heal case.
audit.corrected: Untargetable frames, the 900-range Q, the pack heal and Grievous Wounds all stated with cooldowns.

audit.why: Eviscerate's 11s-to-7s window is when LeBlanc is allowed to step in; R's 110s-to-80s is when the lane is safe at all.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned only as 'his sustain' in itemization.
audit.why: Eviscerate fully heals her packmates on a 7s cooldown at rank 5, which is what wins her extended fights.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] now names Grievous Wounds and the 7-second heal.

edits.before: Naafiri is an early-game bully whose dash combo and packmates can burst you down fast if you're caught overextended without your clone up. The key is never trading in melee range on cooldown — bait her all-in with the clone, let her commit her dashes into the fake, and punish with your real body once she's spent her mobility. Her damage is genuinely scary in short trades, but she has no ranged tools, so playing at max range with Sigil poke keeps you safe while still applying pressure.
edits.after: Naafiri is an early bully whose Darkin Daggers reach 900 range, out-ranging your Sigil's 700, and the second dagger hits harder once the bleed is on you. Never trade in melee range on cooldown — bait Eviscerate with the clone, let her spend the dash into the fake, and punish with your real body while it sits on its 11-second cooldown. Levels 2 to 5 are your window: the Q-W double proc chunks her, and her packmates take your W damage on the way through the wave.

edits.before: At 6 your full combo (W-Q-Sigil-R) reaches out and kills her before her Eviscerate dash can close the distance, provided you don't get caught standing still after your engage. Her ultimate lets her summon extra packmates for pick potential, so ward river and respect all-in windows when she's grouped with jungle pressure, but in a straight 1v1 she cannot out-scale your ranged burst once you're both level 6 with items. Keep baiting her commitment with the clone; her kit falls apart the moment her dashes are down.
edits.after: At 6 your full combo can kill her, but Hounds' Pursuit locks on from 900 range and its recast grants a shield, so she picks the moment, not you. The Call of the Pack — 26s at rank 1, 18s at rank 5 — turns her untargetable mid-commit and blanks a mimicked burst outright, so wait it out rather than dumping into it. Ward river, respect her all-in whenever her jungler is near, and take the fight only while Eviscerate is down; with her dashes spent the kit really does fall apart.

edits.before: Naafiri stays dangerous as a dive-and-reset assassin who wants to jump your backline off a takedown, but she has no way to close on you if you play at range and use your clone to scout or bait dashes before she can commit. As long as you avoid getting isolated in melee range without cooldowns up, your burst and mobility keep this matchup solidly in your favor into the late game.
edits.after: Naafiri stays dangerous as a dive assassin, and Hounds' Pursuit is a 900-range lock-on she never has to aim, so playing at range is not an answer by itself. Use the clone to scout, hold Ethereal Chains for the moment she lands instead of spending it early, and keep Grievous Wounds on her so Eviscerate's full pack heal cannot carry the extended fight.
